notes.title: Exciting News! The Assistant Season 2 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Dear Players and Followers,

We are thrilled to announce that The Assistant Season 2 will soon be available on Steam! Get ready to continue the adventure, filled with even more action, intrigue, and deepening relationships with the girls you love.

Season 2 picks up where the first season left off, plunging you back into the captivating world of The Assistant. Expect new challenges, unexpected twists, and the chance to further explore the dynamics with Sarah, Lisa, Piper, and more.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don’t forget to add The Assistant Season 2 to your wishlist to be the first to experience the new chapters of this thrilling journey.

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2994260/The_Assistant_Season_2/
